Open Graph tags ensure professional previews when shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, and Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. Including the price point and free searches creates transparency and filters for qualified leads.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Your AI Business Partner. Ready When You Are."

Subheading: "Gideon is your Claude-powered assistant for trade and business decisions. Ask anything—get instant, professional answers. Try three searches free."
improvements.rationale: The headline establishes Gideon as a reliable partner rather than just a tool, building trust and positioning it for busy professionals. 'Ready When You Are' implies 24/7 availability without overpromising. The subheading clearly communicates the Claude-powered technology (credibility), the use case (trade and business), the benefit (instant answers), and the low-risk entry point (three free searches). This structure addresses visitor questions: What is it? What does it do? Why should I try it?

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to become a member to continue. Membership starts from just US$2 per day, giving you unlimited access to Gideon's AI-powered trade and business support, voice chat, and your own members workspace. Choose monthly or annual billing—annual members save 30 percent.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common conversion-point question: what happens at the paywall. By clearly explaining the transition from free trial to paid membership, it reduces friction and uncertainty, reinforcing trust while highlighting value and savings to encourage sign-up.
